products.name: Camera On Smooth & Blur Primer
products.desc: A silicone-free blurring primer that fills the look of pores on contact and gives foundation a flat, photo-ready surface. Grips makeup for up to 12 hours without drying the skin down.

products.name: Melt Touch Ultra-Hydrating Primer
products.desc: A watery gel primer that melts in and leaves skin cushioned rather than tacky. Best under dewy or satin foundations on dry and dehydrated skin.

products.name: Good Grip Hydrating Primer
products.desc: A hyaluronic-rich gripping primer that holds makeup through heat and humidity. Genuinely useful in Karachi and Lahore summers where everything else slides.

products.name: Good Grip Ultra-Blur Primer
products.desc: The mattifying counterpart to the original Good Grip. Soft-focus powders blur texture while the grip base keeps foundation locked in place on oily skin.

products.name: Glacier Glo Smoothing Primer
products.desc: A cooling, slip-heavy primer with a faint pearl that lifts dull skin before base. Layers cleanly under both liquid and cushion foundations.

products.name: Even Better Colour Correcting Primer
products.desc: A sheer corrector base in three tones — green for redness, lavender for sallowness, peach for dark circles. Use in patches, not all over.

products.name: Pore Eraser Blurring Stick
products.desc: A twist-up balm stick for targeted blurring across the nose, chin and cheeks. Press it in with a finger rather than dragging.

products.name: Complexion Pro Long Lasting Breathable Matte Foundation
products.desc: Medium-to-full coverage with a true matte finish that stays comfortable rather than tight. The bestselling base of the range, in eight shades.

products.name: Skinfinite Hydrating Foundation
products.desc: A skin-like hydrating base with buildable medium coverage and a soft glow. Sits beautifully on dry skin without clinging to flakes.

products.name: Lock & Go Long-Lasting Cushion Foundation
products.desc: A refillable cushion compact for touch-ups on the move. Tap, don't sweep, and the coverage builds without going cakey.

products.name: Hideaway Full-Coverage Concealer
products.desc: A creamy high-coverage concealer that lifts dark circles without settling into fine lines. Also works to carve out brows and clean up liner.

products.name: Like Magic 12HR Full Coverage Concealer
products.desc: A longwear matte concealer for spot coverage and blemishes. Dries down firmly, so blend fast and set it while it is still moving.

products.name: Wake Up Call Undereye Colour Corrector
products.desc: A peach-toned corrector that neutralises blue and grey under the eyes before concealer goes on. A little goes a long way.

products.name: Blur In A Bottle Loose Setting Powder
products.desc: A finely milled loose powder for baking and setting without flashback. Translucent suits most, banana brightens under the eyes.

products.name: Camera On Blurring Setting Powder Balm
products.desc: A powder-to-balm hybrid that presses into the skin instead of sitting on top. Good over creams where loose powder would look dusty.

products.name: Baked Glow Setting Powder
products.desc: A baked, faintly luminous powder that sets without flattening the skin. Sweep lightly — it builds glow quickly.

products.name: Hydro-Touch Refreshing Setting Powder
products.desc: A weightless setting powder with a cooling finish for long days in heat. Keeps shine down without going chalky by evening.

products.name: Color Bloom Liquid Blush
products.desc: A pigmented liquid blush that blends to a seamless skin finish. Two drops is genuinely enough — start smaller than you think.

products.name: Buttery Bliss Blush Stick
products.desc: A creamy stick blush that draws on and melts out with a fingertip. Layer over cream products before any powder goes down.

products.name: Glass Glow Blush Stick
products.desc: A sheer, glassy blush stick that reads more like flushed skin than makeup. Best on bare or lightly covered skin.

products.name: Sweet Cheeks Blush Trio
products.desc: Three complementary matte powder blushes in one pan — use alone or blend together. Finely pressed, so no fallout on the cheeks.

products.name: Glow Bloom Liquid Highlighter
products.desc: A liquid highlighter you can mix into foundation or place on the high points. Reflects rather than glitters.

products.name: Buttery Bling Highlight Stick
products.desc: A cream highlight stick with a fine, wet-looking sheen. Draw on the cheekbone and tap out with a damp sponge.

products.name: Sun Sculpt Liquid Contour
products.desc: A cool-toned liquid contour that mimics real shadow instead of reading orange. Three shades cover fair through deep.

products.name: Precision Sculpt Liquid Contour Duo
products.desc: Contour and a matching soft highlight in one double-ended tube. Built for quick, precise nose and jaw work.

products.name: Snatch 'n' Define Stick
products.desc: A firm cream contour stick that holds a sharp line before you blend it. Better than liquid for beginners learning placement.

products.name: Dream Touch Bronzer
products.desc: A warm powder bronzer for adding colour back after foundation. Use a fluffy brush and build in thin layers.

products.name: Lock'd In Setting Spray
products.desc: A fine-mist setting spray that locks makeup down for 16 hours. The mist is genuinely fine, so it melts powder edges instead of spotting them.

products.name: Matte Fresh Setting Spray
products.desc: A shine-controlling finish spray for oily skin and humid days. Keeps the base matte without that tight, filmy feel.

products.name: Light Me Up Luminous Setting Spray
products.desc: A glow-finishing spray with micro-fine light reflectors. Mist from a distance or it can go patchy on matte foundation.

products.name: Camera On Blurring Waterproof Setting Spray
products.desc: A waterproof, transfer-resistant setting spray for weddings and long events. Needs an oil cleanser to come off properly.

products.name: Lashlighter Up & Out Mascara
products.desc: A curved brush mascara that lifts lashes up and fans them outward. Builds length first, volume on the second coat.

products.name: All-In-One Primer & Tubing Volume Mascara
products.desc: A white primer on one end and a tubing mascara on the other. The tubes slide off with warm water — no raccoon eyes, no rubbing.

products.name: Pro Precision Waterproof Liquid Eyeliner
products.desc: A 0.5mm felt tip that holds its point through a full wing. Waterproof formula that does not flake off by mid-afternoon.

products.name: Boldline Longwear Multi-Function Gel Liner
products.desc: A retractable gel pencil soft enough to tightline and firm enough to smudge out before it sets. Sets fast — work one eye at a time.

products.name: Big N' Bright Eye Pencil
products.desc: A brightening pencil for the waterline and inner corner. Nude reads more natural than white on most skin tones.

products.name: Streamline Brow & Eyeliner Gel
products.desc: One gel that does hair-stroke brows and a clean liner with the same angled tip. Sets waterproof once it dries.

products.name: Set Me Up Brow Gel
products.desc: A laminating brow gel that holds hairs brushed up all day without crunch. Clear works over pencil, tinted works alone.

products.name: Creamsicle Eyeshadow Stick
products.desc: A blendable cream shadow stick that becomes a full eye look in about thirty seconds. Set with powder if your lids crease.

products.name: Crystal Jelly Glaze Stick
products.desc: A jelly-textured glaze that lays down a wash of wet-look sparkle. Pat with a fingertip rather than blending with a brush.

products.name: Lunar Jelly Frosty Eyeshadow Stick
products.desc: A frosted jelly shadow with a cool, glassy finish. Sits beautifully over a matte crease shade.

products.name: Prismalight Baked Gelee Eyeshadow Duo

products.name: The Everywhere 4-In-1 Pen
products.desc: Four coordinated shades in one pen for eyes, brows and inner corners. Built for travel and touch-ups in a small bag.

products.name: Double Dot Freckle Pen
